name: Gnome Improvement
summary: In Ironforge, Talvash del Kissel hopes to restore his craft with a ring from Gnomeregan. He offers to improve the old band for an adventurer who brings silver and moss agate.

sections.title: A Gnomish Artisan in Exile
sections.body: Talvash del Kissel fled Gnomeregan after troggs brought the city down and radiation followed. He now lives in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, short on coin and materials. The gnome jeweler and tinkerer is determined to prove his skills remain sharp, even in exile.

sections.title: Upgrading the Old Band
sections.body: Talvash recognizes the ring he once made in Gnomeregan, now cleaned by the Sparklematic 5200. Rather than send the adventurer away with a plain band, he offers to improve it. Silver and moss agate, worked into a delicate lattice, turn the old ring into a finer piece.

faq.answer: Talvash del Kissel is a gnome jeweler and craftsman living in exile in Ironforge. Before Gnomeregan fell, he ran a small jewelry shop there. One of his rings can be recovered and brought to him in the Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What is the history behind the ring being upgraded?
aliases: where does the ring come from
faq.answer: The ring began as one of several plain bands Talvash made in his Gnomeregan shop. A Dark Iron dwarf carried one into the ruins, where adventurers can retrieve it and clean it in the Sparklematic 5200. Talvash offers to add silver and moss agate lattice work to improve it.

faq.q: Why does Talvash ask the player to provide the reagents?
aliases: why do i need silver and moss agate
why does talvash have no materials
faq.answer: Talvash has run out of materials and is short on money after fleeing Gnomeregan. He asks for silver and moss agate so he can make the lattice work.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
faq.answer: The trail begins in Gnomeregan, where a Grime-Encrusted Ring can be found on enemies. Clean it in the Sparklematic 5200, then follow the initials 'TdK' to Talvash in Ironforge.

faq.q: Is Talvash bitter about his situation in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Talvash laments his unjust financial hole, but keeps his spirits and professional pride. He believes that once he is back on his feet, he will be renowned across Azeroth for crafting the finest trinkets.

faq.q: Does the Horde have access to this quest?
faq.answer: No. Horde adventurers who clean Grime-Encrusted objects in Gnomeregan are sent to Nogg in Orgrimmar instead of Talvash in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Talvash's pride in his craft, even after exile from his homeland and the loss of his materials.
As a miner, you can provide the silver and moss agate Talvash needs for his jewelry work.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can help refugees from Gnomeregan through the ties between the fallen capital and Ironforge.
